<!--

<script lang="ts">
import type { ProfileLabels } from "./profile-form.types";

export type ProfileFormProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  labels: ProfileLabels;
  layout?: "stacked" | "split";
  avatar?: "show" | "hide";
  prefs?: "show" | "hide";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Form from "../compose/Form.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Input from "../compose/Input.vue";
import Label from "../compose/Label.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Switch from "../compose/Switch.vue";
import Textarea from "../compose/Textarea.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import Field from "../components/field.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import Panel from "../components/panel.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  labels,
  layout = "stacked",
  avatar = "show",
  prefs = "show",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ProfileFormProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : ((title && id) ? tpl('{0}-t', id) : undefined))"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="panel-section"

    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4 py-8" data-slot="container">
      <Panel
        :title="title"
        :description="text"
        :id="id"
        :class="cn((((tone as string) === 'muted') ? 'bg-muted' : ''))"
      >
        <Form method="dialog" class="gap-6" data-slot="profile-form">
          <Grid :cols="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? '1-2' : '1')" class="items-start gap-8">
            <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
              <Group v-if="((avatar as string) === 'show')" gap="4" align="center" data-slot="avatar">
                <MediaFrame :alt="labels.picture" ratio="1/1" class="size-16 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" type="button">
                  {{ labels.change }}
                </Button>
              </Group>
              <Field :label="labels.name" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-name', id)">
                <Input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" :id="tpl('{0}-name', id)" data-slot="field" />
              </Field>
              <Field :label="labels.email" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-email', id)">
                <Input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" :id="tpl('{0}-email', id)" data-slot="field" />
              </Field>
              <Field :label="labels.bio" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-bio', id)">
                <Textarea :rows="4" name="bio" :id="tpl('{0}-bio', id)" data-slot="field" />
              </Field>
            </Stack>
            <Stack v-if="((prefs as string) === 'show')" gap="4" align="stretch" data-slot="prefs">
              <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="bold">
                {{ labels.prefs }}
              </Title>
              <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
                <Label :for="tpl('{0}-updates', id)" class="text-sm" :id="tpl('{0}-updates-label', id)">
                  {{ labels.updates }}
                </Label>
                <Switch name="updates" :id="tpl('{0}-updates', id)" :aria-labelledby="tpl('{0}-updates-label', id)" />
              </Group>
              <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
                <Label :for="tpl('{0}-alerts', id)" class="text-sm" :id="tpl('{0}-alerts-label', id)">
                  {{ labels.alerts }}
                </Label>
                <Switch name="alerts" :id="tpl('{0}-alerts', id)" :aria-labelledby="tpl('{0}-alerts-label', id)" />
              </Group>
            </Stack>
          </Grid>
          <Group gap="2" class="flex-wrap">
            <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit">
              {{ labels.save }}
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button">
              {{ labels.cancel }}
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Form>
      </Panel>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
